payload.title: Teacher guide

sections.heading: Before instruction
sections.text: Administer the quiz as a diagnostic without feedback. Route tens/ones errors to the worksheet. Keep this separate from the end-of-unit measure. All numerical contexts in this package are invented classroom examples, not reported local measurements or prices.

sections.heading: Differentiation and independence
sections.text: Offer oral directions, large print and a place chart during instruction. Fade the chart before the independent stage. A scribe may transcribe without supplying steps. Record tutoring, hints and collaboration as assistance. Do not count assisted work as independent evidence.

sections.heading: Assessment and follow-up
sections.text: Use the withheld summative form after instruction. Score reasoning through authorized human moderation using the protected rubric. Plan delayed retrieval only after policy approval. Revisit the misconception scene when learners compare by digit count.
